ready_metadata.meaning: Ready for A to supply immutable external artifacts and lock resources. Not acceptance of Qwen training or generation quality.
ready_metadata.file_hash_policy: All delivered files except READY.json itself are listed, avoiding a self-hash cycle. Runtime outputs and private populated manifests are not bundled.

commands.join_B_snapshot: python run_alignment.py join-snapshots --images private/image_features/snapshot.json --descriptions private/B_descriptions/snapshot.json --output private/joined
commands.A_lock: python lock_manifest.py --executor A --scope full --attest-original --model private/official_qwen --snapshot private/joined/snapshot.json --decoder-export private/D_export/export.json --replay-train private/instruction_train.jsonl --replay-eval private/instruction_eval.jsonl --python-path private/D_code --output alignment.locked.json
commands.A_paired_run: python run_alignment.py run-pair --executor A --device cuda --manifest alignment.locked.json --output runs/paired_short
commands.feature_only_decode: python run_alignment.py decode --manifest alignment.locked.json --features runs/description_features.safetensors --output runs/description_rgb.safetensors

CPU_evidence.timing_scope: Suite bodies only; excludes interpreter/import overhead. Each command has a 300-second check timeout.

external_artifacts_required: Official original Qwen local model and processor, immutable revision and complete file hashes; no P2 weights
Frozen E: bundled official vision tower or separate strictly equal official vision state
D completed immutable export with weights, factory/local dependency sources, representation and normalization contracts
Raw image/features/RGB snapshot with fixed 640 train + 80 val IDs and hashes
B completed immutable original-Qwen candidate-description snapshot on exactly the same fixed IDs/hashes/splits
Disjoint instruction replay train and held-out rubric evaluation files
A resource/scope lock shared by both interfaces

paired_defaults.permitted_scope_alternative: last4 explicitly labeled and identical for both
paired_defaults.validation: same fixed first 8 of 80 val images in each of 3 modes
paired_defaults.sampling: deterministic full free autoregressive 64; no true history

numeric_contract.target: raw official post-merger, then shared optional train-only standardization
numeric_contract.direct: identity on M hidden states, trained toward same z distribution as MLP
numeric_contract.decoder_gradient: parameters frozen; input gradient retained for pixel-loss training
numeric_contract.normalization: same statistics and raw/model D boundary for both interfaces; no independent refit

resource_estimate.method: Nominal P=0.8B, trainable full ~0.7B or last4 ~0.07-0.10B; FP32 master parameters+gradients+two FP32 Adam states, BF16 autocast in M; add activations, vocabulary logits, workspace, cache and frozen D separately.
resource_estimate.D_extra: 4*D_parameter_count bytes plus forward/backward activations; unknown until A provides D
resource_estimate.guarantee: None; A must lock against actual resources; no automatic full/last4 fallback
